name: LiveProteinBench
description: LiveProteinBench is a contamination-free, multimodal benchmark of 12 tasks designed to evaluate large language model performance on protein property and function prediction using novel protein data validated after 2025.
reputation: A very new, contamination-aware benchmark with early-stage adoption, mainly relevant to protein-focused multimodal and bioinformatics model evaluation.
notes: Focuses on novel protein data to avoid contamination; highlights challenges in multimodal fusion and importance of chain-of-thought reasoning.
